newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 25.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Tuesday and main factors likely to affect trading.

* Stocks are seen moving sideways with an upward bias but any rally will be dogged by lingering concerns of a U.S. interest rate hike, says Francisco Trinidad, research head at DBS Securities Phils Inc.
* Further lack of buying incentives are likely to see the main index moving sideways, says Sun Hung Kai Securities in its daily outlook.
